title: Turning Designs Into Study Questions
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting turning designs into study questions to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish a design preference (untestable) from a design hypothesis (testable) using the manipulation/measure/comparison test
Rewrite a vague storyboard note as a study question with a named independent variable, an observable dependent variable, and a baseline
Choose a single primary measure and justify excluding plausible-but-irrelevant outcomes
Predict in advance which result would send you back to revise the frame

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
